expectations.text: The empty-state instruction contains all 3 parts: what to look for (zero-data screens), violation (text only, no illustration), correct (illustration alongside text)
expectations.evidence: The instruction reads: 'On every zero-data screen (no books, no search results, fixture=empty), verify that an illustrative graphic...' (what to look for). 'Violation: the empty state contains only a text string or heading with no accompanying illustration element.' (violation). 'Correct: a visible illustration or graphic is rendered next to or above the explanatory text...' (correct).

expectations.text: The transition instruction specifies what to look for (route navigation), what's wrong (white flash, abrupt change), what's right (smooth transition)
expectations.evidence: The instruction reads: 'During every route navigation (clicking links, browser back/forward, programmatic pushes), watch for intermediate visual states...' (what to look for). 'Violation: a fully white or blank frame is visible for any perceptible duration...or the transition appears as an abrupt hard cut with no easing.' (what's wrong). 'Correct: the outgoing page fades, slides, or cross-fades into the incoming page with no intermediate blank frame...' (what's right).

expectations.text: The gutter instruction specifies breakpoints, what's wrong (unequal gaps), what's right (consistent spacing)
expectations.evidence: The instruction reads: 'At each responsive breakpoint (mobile 320px, tablet 768px, desktop 1024px, wide 1440px), measure the gaps...' (breakpoints specified). 'Violation: any gap between cards differs from the others by more than 1px, or outer padding is inconsistent...' (what's wrong). 'Correct: all horizontal gaps are identical, all vertical gaps are identical, and outer padding matches the grid's gutter token at every measured breakpoint.' (what's right).

expectations.text: No instruction is a vague one-liner like 'Check that X looks good'
expectations.evidence: All three instructions are multi-sentence, structured, and specific. The shortest instruction (empty-states) is a full paragraph covering context, violation, and correct behavior. None contain vague phrases like 'looks good' or 'check that it works'.

expectations.text: Each instruction is specific enough that a visual-qa agent could deterministically judge pass/fail
expectations.evidence: Empty-states: specifies icon size threshold (>48x48), specific fixture to use (fixture=empty), clear binary presence/absence test. Transitions: specifies 'one or more frames' threshold for white flash. Spacing: specifies 1px tolerance for gap differences and references design tokens for comparison. All three provide measurable, binary pass/fail criteria.

expectations.text: All three blocks have appropriate scope, group, and priority fields
expectations.evidence: Empty-states: scope='src/components/*EmptyState*', group='empty-states', priority=2. Transitions: scope='src/**/*', group='transitions', priority=2. Spacing: scope='src/components/*Grid*', group='spacing', priority=2. All three blocks have all three required fields present and populated with appropriate values.
